about.title: About

intro.heading: Coffee, code, and a little magic.
intro.p1: I'm Bohdan — a software engineer who lives on the part of a product people actually touch. For 3+ years I've been building web interfaces, and for the last year and a half I've been shipping cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter.
intro.p2: I started on the web with React and Next.js, then picked up Flutter when I wanted the same ideas to run natively in someone's pocket. These days I move between the two — a Next.js dashboard one week, a Flutter app the next.
intro.p3: What I care about doesn't change with the framework: architecture a future me can read, interfaces that feel obvious, and products that survive contact with real users.

items.title: Architecture first
items.text: I'd rather spend an hour naming things well than a week untangling them later. Structure is what keeps a project moving after month three.

items.title: UX isn't decoration
items.text: If a user has to stop and think about the interface, the interface failed. Smoothness is a feature, not a finishing touch.

items.title: Ship, then sharpen
items.text: A live product beats a perfect plan. I ship early and keep refining what real usage — not guesswork — reveals.

beyond.heading: Away from the screen
beyond.text: When I step away from the editor, I keep the curiosity fed — new tools to try, ideas to sketch, and the occasional rabbit hole I probably didn't need to go down. It usually loops back into the work anyway.
